_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.note: The famous paper popularised it. The method is older, and it began outside AI.

beats.name: Seppo Linnainmaa
beats.role: Described the method in his University of Helsinki master's thesis, as reverse mode automatic differentiation, with no mention of neural networks.

beats.name: Paul Werbos
beats.role: First neural network specific use of it, according to Schmidhuber. Wikipedia dates the standard form to 1982.

beats.name: Rumelhart, Hinton, Williams
beats.role: Published Learning representations by back-propagating errors in Nature, showing hidden layers learn useful internal representations.

beats.text: He says he never claimed to have invented it.
beats.note: His contribution, he says, was showing it could learn useful internal representations.

beats.text: Credit usually goes to whoever made the idea work, not whoever had it first.
